world.title: U.S. Republicans derail bid to impeach Hegseth
world.summary: House Republicans on November 10, 2026, blocked an impeachment effort against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, related to the Iran war. The resolution was sent to the Judiciary Committee, allowing Democrats to maintain a potential path for impeachment after gaining control in January. This decision marked a significant victory for President Donald Trump following the recent midterm elections.

world.title: U.S. Army member arrested in U.K. for alleged Russian links
world.summary: A U.S. Army member was arrested in Gloucestershire, U.K., on November 10, 2026, for alleged espionage linked to Russia. The 41-year-old, whose identity remains undisclosed, is under investigation by British authorities. Officials emphasized that this case is part of ongoing, separate counterterrorism investigations, highlighting the seriousness of the allegations against the individual.

world.title: US House Rejects Effort To Impeach Defence Chief Pete Hegseth
world.summary: The US House of Representatives rejected a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday, related to his conduct and handling of the Iran war. This decision marked a victory for President Donald Trump following his party's significant midterm election losses. The vote reflects ongoing challenges within the Republican Party as they navigate post-election dynamics.

business.title: Local partner wanted for Xiaomi ‘home’ coming
business.summary: Xiaomi is exploring partnerships with potential Indian suppliers as it plans to expand its product range beyond air purifiers to include air conditioners, refrigerators, and washing machines. This initiative is in the early stages, according to an anonymous source. The move reflects Xiaomi's commitment to growing its presence in the Indian market and diversifying its product offerings.

business.title: Stocks in news: Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL and Bajaj Finance
business.summary: Indian equity markets will resume trading on Wednesday following the Diwali holiday. Investors are focusing on key stocks including Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL, and Bajaj Finance amid Q2 earnings and corporate news. The Nifty index faces immediate resistance levels between 25,150 and 25,200 after ending Monday's session with modest gains.

business.title: Blackstone to buy about 16% of IIFL Finance in latest foreign bet on Indian lenders
business.summary: Blackstone will acquire approximately 16% of IIFL Finance for 50 billion rupees (about $535 million), as announced by the Indian non-bank lender. This investment is part of a broader trend of global firms investing in India's financial sector, aiming to tap into its expanding credit market. IIFL's capital raise totals 64.14 billion rupees ($682.87 million).

technology.title: Samsung's Galaxy S27 lineup takes shape with new dummy unit leak
technology.summary: A leak has revealed a dummy unit of Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup, providing an early glimpse into next year's models. As the year ends, attention shifts to holiday festivities and shopping, with Black Friday deals attracting consumers. However, no significant new tech releases are anticipated in the immediate future, as focus remains on existing products.

technology.title: Apple’s iPod Turns 25: Here’s the Song Catalog That Rode Wit You
technology.summary: On October 23, 2001, Apple launched the iPod, revolutionizing portable music. To celebrate its 25th anniversary, Apple Music introduced an easter egg that mimics the iPod's click wheel experience. Popular songs from its debut year included Nelly's "Ride Wit Me," Alicia Keys' "Fallin'," and Outkast's "Ms. Jackson," allowing users to enjoy music on the go.

technology.title: Apple TV adds sign language November 13 for 'Being Heumann'
technology.summary: Apple TV will introduce a sign language interpretation feature on November 13, aimed at enhancing accessibility for Deaf audiences. This feature will initially be available for select titles, allowing viewers to activate American or British Sign Language. Real interpreters will appear on screen, providing a more inclusive viewing experience for users.

sports.title: Shubman Gill, KL Rahul to miss final two ODIs for Test preparations; Rayudu, Karthik predict India's playing XI changes
sports.summary: Shubman Gill and KL Rahul will miss the final two ODIs against New Zealand to focus on Test preparations. India leads the five-match ODI series 2-0, with the third match in Hamilton abandoned due to rain. Former players Ambati Rayudu and Dinesh Karthik anticipate changes in India's playing XI for the upcoming matches.

sports.title: Is Frenkie de Jong undervalued? Barcelona star responds to Xavi’s comments
sports.summary: Frenkie de Jong addressed comments from Barcelona coach Xavi regarding player valuation, stating that assessments should not rely solely on goals and assists. He emphasized the subjective nature of opinions about player performance, noting that many viewers do not watch an entire match. De Jong expressed a feeling of being undervalued among some observers, highlighting differing perspectives in football.

sports.title: Ravindra, Conway named in New Zealand squad for India Tests
sports.summary: Rachin Ravindra and Devon Conway have been named in New Zealand's squad for the upcoming Test series against India. Both players, along with wicketkeeper Tom Blundell, are currently recovering from injuries. They are working towards being fit to participate in the first Test scheduled to take place in Wellington. The match is set to begin soon.

health.title: Silent heart disease can strike without warning
health.summary: Hyderabad cardiologist Dr. Manoj Kumar Agarwala emphasizes the significance of early detection in heart disease, which can often remain asymptomatic for years. He warns that unnoticed symptoms may result in severe complications, including heart attacks and strokes. Proactive prevention and awareness of silent signs are crucial for maintaining heart health and reducing the risk of serious cardiovascular events.

health.title: High-Protein Packaged Foods May Not Be As Healthy As They Look
health.summary: High-protein packaged foods may not be as beneficial as they appear. While protein is essential for health, opting for high-protein versions of typically low-protein items might not be the best strategy for increasing protein intake. Consumers should be cautious, as these products may contain unhealthy additives or ingredients that negate their perceived health benefits.

health.title: HHS Vaccine Task Force Misses Report Deadline
health.summary: The HHS vaccine task force has missed its deadline to release a report on vaccine timing and sequencing. Public health advocates express concern over the potential impact of the delayed report on public trust in vaccines. They fear that the eventual release may further undermine confidence in vaccination efforts, highlighting the importance of timely and transparent communication regarding vaccine strategies.

science.title: Common balance tests and their association with falls
science.summary: A study analyzed the association between common balance tests and self-reported falls among 57,720 adults aged 45 and older in India. Significant associations were found between falls and the ability to complete the semi-tandem, side-by-side, and full-tandem tests. The side-by-side and 60-second full-tandem tests showed the strongest links to falls, particularly among both genders.

science.title: NASA Announces $1 Million Competition For Students Developing Future Moon Base Solutions
science.summary: NASA has launched a $1 million competition for students to propose solutions for a future Moon Base. Open to high school and college students across the U.S., the challenge encourages creativity and innovation. Participants are not required to have prior specialized engineering or technical experience, allowing a diverse range of ideas to be submitted for consideration.

science.title: What would Earth without life be like? US scientists create a simulation to find out
science.summary: Scientists at the University of Washington created a computer simulation to explore Earth's evolution over five billion years, including a future without life. The study showed that Earth could maintain habitable conditions for billions of years even in the absence of living organisms. This research provides insights into planetary conditions and the potential for life elsewhere in the universe.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 11, 2026, horoscopes suggest that Taurus should embrace their gentle and generous nature. The cosmos is aligned to reward these qualities, igniting a spark within individuals. This day encourages reflection on personal goals, relationships, and aspirations. It is a favorable time to explore feelings and ideas that resonate deeply, guiding decisions and actions moving forward.

entertainment.title: Cancer Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026
entertainment.summary: Cancer individuals are advised to balance their emotional investments with logical thinking on November 11, 2026. While passion is important, this horoscope suggests employing a more strategic approach to tasks. The guidance emphasizes the need for smart decision-making, indicating that a blend of heart and mind will lead to better outcomes in various aspects of life.

entertainment.title: Libra Horoscope Today: November 11, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, November 11, 2026, Libras may feel trapped in repetitive cycles, leading to a sense of frustration. While valuing security and stability, they are encouraged to break free from these constraints. The horoscope suggests that focusing on new opportunities rather than material distractions can lead to personal growth and fulfillment. Embracing change may prove beneficial for Libras today.
